item.title: 🔵 Grindr to Pay £26 Million to Settle U.K. Claims Over HIV Status Data Sharing
item.description:
Why this matters: Hospitality-system impact — consider guest services, PMS/POS, and property operations.

Grindr, which is the largest LGBTQ+ dating app, was sued in April 2024, accusing it of violating U.K. privacy laws by sharing sensitive data for commercial purposes such as advertising.

item.title: 🔴 Critical MikroTik Vulnerability - Patch Now, (Sun, Sep 6th)
item.description:
